mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may increase risk of adverse CNS effects and arrhythmias; memantine has potential for additive effects on renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, sodium) regularly; ensure adequate supplementation if needed; monitor for CNS adverse effects and cardiac arrhythmias; assess renal function periodically.
